node.doc:
What the product app may say about stuck work: how much there is, and

where it is repaired (RFD-2n2tcfe2 determination 10).

removing the indication, because "some of it is invisible" is the one

thing a reader must not conclude from a smaller number.

node.name: every_class_of_stuck_work_reaches_one_surface
node.doc:
One workspace, one record of every class, read through the one

registry an operator reads — which is the claim the whole

programme makes and the only one no single slice could prove.



Each slice tested its own source against its own store. This

asserts they compose: five subsystems that share no schema, no

release and no table answer one query in one vocabulary, each

declaring what may be done to its records.



Against a workspace the testkit migrates in an ephemeral Postgres

(RFD-fpg4tnq2), which it seeds with one record of each class.

node.name: bounds
node.doc:
How long this source keeps trying (determinations 5 and 17).



There is no default. An unbounded retry loop is the defect this

programme exists to retire, so a source that joins the surface

says what its bounds are rather than inheriting a number someone

else chose.

node.name: fencing
node.doc:
Whether this source's completion path is fenced

(determination 17).



No default either, and for the same reason: a source that has not

answered would be assumed safe to reclaim from, which is the one

wrong answer.
